source_references.title: Environmental Fate MCP governed scalar erosion/sediment validation profile

limitations: Fit classifications are reviewer-facing screening diagnostics, not calibration, optimization, regulatory acceptance, or proof of scientific adequacy.
Observed and predicted records are paired only by record_id and supported scalar quantity; spatial routing, rainfall-runoff generation, and WEPP execution remain out of scope.
Default thresholds are governance thresholds for scalar screening QA and must not be treated as universal watershed model performance criteria.
applicability_note: Use after RUSLE, MUSLE, or sediment-associated load screening when inline observed field/event records are available for reviewer-facing fit diagnostics.
